content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Roorkee Project Consultant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 07-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Consultant position at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 07 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Consultant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD degree along with at least 2 years of relevant experience in the field to be eligible for the Project Consultant position.

faq.question: Q3. How will candidates be selected for the Project Consultant position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Consultant role at IIT Roorkee primarily involves an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Consultant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Consultant position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 1,47,000 per month, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the information available, there is no application fee mentioned for the Project Consultant recruitment at IIT Roorkee. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for confirmation.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies for the Project Consultant position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Consultant position advertised by the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the Project Consultant position at IIT Roorkee are to be submitted via email. Ensure all required documents are attached and the subject line is correctly mentioned.

faq.question: Q8. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job is based at the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee, located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand, with the pincode 247667.

faq.question: Q9. When is the interview scheduled for the Project Consultant role?
faq.answer: The interview for the Project Consultant position is scheduled to be held on 10 September 2026. Candidates should be prepared for the interview on this date.

faq.question: Q10. What kind of experience is required for the Project Consultant position?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in the field related to the research project to be eligible for the Project Consultant role.
